full_judgment: 5. The defendant Nos. 1 and 2 contested the suit by filing written statement denying all the allegations made in the plaint contending inter alia, that the suit is not maintainable without a suit for partition and also denied that they dispossessed the plaintiff from the suit land on the date stated in the plaint or any other date. The case of the defendants are that plot No. 1362 measuring 44 sataks and plot No. 1363 measuring 35 sataks under khatian No. 99 are the suit land. The defendant No. 1 purchased in total 50 sataks of land from plot Nos. 1362 and 1363 from different persons and has been in possession of the same by constructing house and living therein with their family. While Ekhlas Mia the defendant No. 1 in possession he transferred 26 sataks of land to the plaintiff from plot No. 1362 by sale deed dated 17-5-1983 out of 57 sataks. After sale he remains in possession of 31 sataks land wherein his homestead and other establishment exists. The defendant No. 1 by sale deeds dated 1-6-1991 and 3-6-1991 transferred the said 31 sataks land to the defendant No. 2 and delivered possession of the same.
